Interface ContractInfoDTO

All Known Implementing Classes:
ContractInfoDTO.Reussite, ContractInfoDTO.TrickTaking
public sealed interface ContractInfoDTO permits ContractInfoDTO.TrickTaking, ContractInfoDTO.Reussite
DTO for a single Barbu contract, sent as part of VariantInfoDTO.

Provides the domain identity (id, displayName) alongside a normalized description of the contract mechanics so the frontend can render rules dynamically without hardcoding knowledge of specific contracts.

The family discriminator tells the frontend which play area to expect (trick vs tableau), while scoring rules and lead restrictions are always sent as flat lists (composites are pre-flattened by the mapper).
